summary.text: Nick Miller is a Democratic state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 14 in the Lehigh Valley since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. Ballotpedia lists Republican Omy Maldonado as his opponent.

paragraphs.text: Nick Miller was born in Allentown, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Allentown Central Catholic High School in 2013, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a B.S. in finance from Penn State University in 2017 and an M.P.A. and a master's in law, both in 2022, from the University of Pennsylvania.
His career experience includes work as an analyst at PricewaterhouseCoopers, as a senior consultant at IBM, and as a realtor.

Miller served as vice president of the Allentown City District school board and as an ambassador of the Greater Lehigh Valley Chamber of Commerce, and he founded the Varricchio-Miller Educational Foundation, a charity, in 2016.
He took office in the state Senate on December 1, 2022.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Urban Affairs and Housing, Communications and Technology, Community, Economic and Recreational Development, Rules and Executive Nominations, and Transportation.
His campaign website lists his priorities as elevating educational opportunities, enhancing community safety, and spurring economic development.
